title: Super-intelligence or Superstition? Exploring Psychological Factors Influencing Belief in AI Predictions about Personal Behavior
summary: This paper explores psychological factors that influence people's belief in AI predictions about their personal behavior, questioning whether such beliefs are based on actual super-intelligence or are a form of superstition. It likely examines cognitive biases, trust in technology, and individual differences that shape acceptance of AI-generated insights.
highlights: Investigates psychological mechanisms behind trust in AI personal predictions
Contrasts rational assessment with superstitious thinking
Relevant to AI ethics and user acceptance

title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training

title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
summary: 本文介绍了如何使用 Sentence Transformers 库训练和微调多向量嵌入模型，包括 ColBERT 等模型，涵盖数据准备、训练流程、损失函数选择及评估方法。
highlights: 多向量嵌入模型（如 ColBERT）通过为每个 token 生成向量，实现更精细的语义匹配。
使用 Sentence Transformers 可以轻松加载预训练模型并微调，支持自定义数据集。
训练时需选择合适的损失函数，如 ColBERT 的 late interaction 损失。
评估阶段可使用信息检索指标（如 MRR、Recall）衡量模型性能。

title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
summary: IBM 发布 Granite 4.2 系列 LLM，介绍其架构设计、训练方法、性能特点及开源生态，强调在代码生成、推理和工具调用方面的优化，并展示与 Hugging Face 的集成。
highlights: Granite 4.2 系列模型在代码生成和推理任务上表现优异，支持多种编程语言。
模型采用创新的架构设计，结合稀疏注意力和混合专家（MoE）技术，提升效率。
开源权重和完整训练细节，便于社区复现和二次开发。
与 Hugging Face 深度集成，提供便捷的部署和微调工具。
